title: Mirai Botnet Investigation
description: Investigate and contain a Mirai botnet infection in the network.
outcomes: Usage of systemctl for service management
Usage of iptables for network traffic control
Investigation of systemd timers and services

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has been experiencing unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation. Initial investigations suggest a possible botnet infection. Your task is to investigate and contain the threat. To proceed, enter the word 'start'.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: Access the sandbox in cloud using the following credentials: To proceed, enter the word 'start'.
levels.local_content: Access the local sandbox using the following credentials: To proceed, enter the word 'start'.

levels.title: Identify the suspicious beacon service
levels.content: Investigate the system services on bot1. Identify the service responsible for beaconing to the C2 server. The service name will be your flag. The flag is the name of the service.
levels.solution: Check the systemd services and look for unusual service names. The suspicious beacon service is named bot-beacon-Hilix.x86.elf.service.

hints.title: First hint
hints.content: Check the systemd services and look for unusual service names.

levels.title: Identify the persistence mechanism
levels.content: Investigate the systemd timers and services on bot1. Identify the persistence mechanism that ensures the malware runs after reboots. The service name will be your flag. The flag is the name of the service.
levels.solution: Look for services related to system updates or health checks. The persistence service is named system-update-checker.service.

hints.title: First hint
hints.content: Look for services related to system updates or health checks.

levels.title: Contain the C2 communication
levels.content: Identify the IP address and port used for C2 communication. Implement a firewall rule to block this communication. The port number will be your flag. The flag is the port number.
levels.solution: Check the beacon script and the C2 listener configuration. The port number used for C2 communication is 2222. Implement a firewall rule to block this communication.

hints.title: First hint
hints.content: Check the beacon script and the C2 listener configuration.
